head: FieldKit puts offline AI, survival guides and maps on your iPhone
dek: FieldKit gives you an AI that runs on your iPhone, 313 practical references and offline maps, so you can look things up without internet. It was #74 among paid Reference apps on the US App Store on 10 November.
details: The references cover water, food, power, first aid, radio and repair, and you can add your own PDFs and manuals. You download what you need while connected. It costs $19.99 with no in-app purchases, by Zachary Alewel, and needs iOS 18.
means: For camping, travel or emergencies, answers stay on your phone when there's no signal.
todo: Download the references and maps you need before you go offline.
